name: kute
description: High performance krunker client made by [cute]
author: NullDev

scripts.start:dev: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --features verbose-logs && bun postbuild.js debug && cross-env KUTE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3030/api cargo run --features editor-ignore,verbose-logs
scripts.start:dev:realapi: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --features verbose-logs && bun postbuild.js debug && cross-env KUTE_API_URL=https://kute.lol/api cargo run --features editor-ignore,verbose-logs
scripts.start:prod: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --release --features packaged,editor-ignore && bun postbuild.js release && cargo run --features editor-ignore
scripts.build: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --release --features packaged,editor-ignore && bun postbuild.js release
scripts.start:perf: bun run build && cross-env KUTE_PERF_RECORDER=1 target/release/kute.exe
scripts.build:auto-update: bun run esbuild && cargo build --workspace --release --features packaged,auto-update,editor-ignore && bun postbuild.js release
scripts.package: bun run build:auto-update && wix build ./resources/installer_script.wxs -ext WixToolset.Util.wixext -o target/kute-setup-x86_64.msi
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p jsconfig.json && tsc -p src/frontend/jsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json
